prompt:
Create the Orc partner to the Human modular stadium atlas in image 1. Image 2 is the exact pixel-art style authority; image 3 shows the accepted bowl and crowded composition. Transparent background, 20 isolated unlabelled assets organized in 5 horizontal rows of 4. Every item must have clear transparent gaps from every neighbor; leave broad gutters around each asset. Preserve the Human sheet's scale, footprint and pixel detail. Mature fantasy connected pixel clusters and strong dark outlines, not sparse chibi characters or smooth 3D.

Orc venue art: battered brown-grey stone, heavy rough timber, riveted dark iron, restrained small spikes, rust-orange/charcoal cloth, patched canvas, dented tankards and warm braziers. Original simple two-tusk football emblem, no copied game logos. Vanilla Barrens/Orgrimmar material mood, but the same modest enclosing bowl dimensions as Human. Orc faces olive-green with small tusks, varied helmets, dark/rust clothing, dense heads/shoulders.

ROW-MAJOR required order:
Row 1: stone standing-ground tile; straight horizontal retaining-wall segment with battered stone and iron/timber cap and posts, flat unforeshortened front elevation, about 3:1 width/height, no torch/banner; isolated field-level locker-room double-door portal front elevation; same doorway passage genuinely overhead.
Row 2: dense front Orc crowd strip; dense right-facing three-quarter/profile Orc crowd strip; square genuine overhead dense Orc heads/shoulders; hanging rust-orange/charcoal banner with original small two-tusk football mark.
Row 3: rough player bench front view; same bench genuine overhead; small patched orange/charcoal Orc canvas pavilion front/three-quarter; same pavilion genuinely overhead.
Row 4: a cluster of dented tankards/cups; iron/timber torch bracket with warm flame; genuine overhead torch/brazier footprint; small rust-orange team pennant and pole.
Row 5: dense BACK-VIEW Orc crowd strip (backs of heads, helmets, shoulders facing away into field); dense LEFT-facing profile Orc crowd strip; ONE resting Orc spectator head/upper torso; EXACT SAME Orc spectator with raised fist/shouting gesture, same body/scale/bottom anchor.

Each crowd strip is continuous shoulder-to-shoulder density, roughly twelve heads across and three staggered rows deep, many small varied faces, almost no gaps, dark overlapping torsos, mostly at rest. No seats, stairs, ground, walls, props or isolated three-person groups in the crowd cells. CrowdTop is genuinely overhead. The two individual fan pose cells are independent animation frames. Wall/door front assets are flat elevations with no baked perspective; the renderer will project them once.

No labels, cell borders, background, painted checkerboard, UI, full stadium scene, players or field markings. True transparent alpha, broad empty margins around all 20 assets.
regionMethod: Read-only connected alpha-component measurement of original output; per-asset transparent frames preserve pixels despite nonuniform rows/columns. No pixel cropping, resizing or background editing.
